offer_catalog.title: Duplicate charge refund
offer_catalog.terms: A refund of the duplicate router rental line, 8.00 per affected bill.

offer_catalog.title: Outage credit
offer_catalog.terms: A 15.00 credit on your next bill for the outage.

offer_catalog.title: Switch to Fiber 300
offer_catalog.terms: Move to the Fiber 300 plan at 45.00 a month from your next bill.

help_articles.title: Refund timing
help_articles.body: Refunds we promise in chat are sent to your payment method within 10 days. Your bank statement is the record that the money arrived.

help_articles.title: Escalations
help_articles.body: Billing questions are handled by Billing Support. Chat agents do not transfer cases to Billing Review; to request a review, describe the charge and the invoices it appears on.

help_articles.title: Outage credits
help_articles.body: If service is down for more than 4 hours, ask for an outage credit in chat.

help_articles.title: Moving your service
help_articles.body: Tell us your new address two weeks before you move.
